_comment: Expected fit bands are Claude's draft of Logan's judgment from his profile; Logan to confirm or adjust. Bands: strong, good, stretch, weak.

postings.title: Systems Administrator (CNIC N6 Systems Administrator)
postings.why: Active Secret is within TS/SCI; AD, VMware, Windows Server, IIS, SQL all on Logan's resume; pay clears floor; Kitsap.

postings.title: Systems Administrator 2 (posting title not confirmed; category listed as 'IT - Hardware')
postings.why: Wants TS/SCI which Logan holds; mid-level sysadmin matches his enclave and VM work.

postings.title: Windows Systems Engineer
postings.employer: Amazon (AWS Utility Computing, Region Services Corporate Infrastructure)
postings.why: Windows engineering with TS/SCI and top pay; closest match to his enclave/VM experience.

postings.title: Systems Administration Lead/Manager
postings.why: Lead/manager sysadmin; his Navy supervision fits but years of civilian sysadmin experience may fall short.

postings.title: Systems Administrator
postings.employer: Not named on posting (a public-sector district is mentioned)
postings.why: Sysadmin in Seattle at $70-80k, right at his floor; clearance is a lever but pay is the cap.

postings.title: Lead Senior Computer Systems Administrator
postings.why: Keyport lead sysadmin; pay range dips below $70k at the bottom but tops at $120k.

postings.title: Senior Systems Administrator
postings.why: Senior sysadmin, strong pay; seniority is a stretch but skills overlap.

postings.title: Systems Administrator
postings.why: Corporate sysadmin, good pay, no clearance edge.
